_doc: Cases both apps' file checks must agree on (data/safety/file_risks.json; src/net/file_risk.rs tests and scripts/tests/file-risk-web.test.js). `head` is the file's first bytes in hex (empty: not known). `kind` null: no word of caution. `words`, when given, is the exact text. `type` and `level` are the file's badge (file_type / fileType): every file has one.

cases.name: setup.exe
cases.words: This is a program (.exe). A program can do anything on your computer: only run it if you trust the person it came from, and scan it with your antivirus first.

cases.name: backup.tar.gz
cases.head: 1f8b0800
cases.words: This is an archive (.tar.gz). What is inside it has not been checked: scan it with your antivirus before you open what it holds, and be careful with any program inside.

cases.name: part.blend

cases.words: Blender files can carry scripts. If Blender asks whether to run them, say no unless you trust the person who shared it.
